mobbin:9b6a37a7-8bbf-4883-a999-463f46cfb.summary: A manager opens a department/role week grid with Conflicts and Overtime counters, overtime cells, Open Shifts rows, Import/Publish, and a Budget Tool footer.
steps: Empty week: Dept, Role, Open Shifts, Import
Populated week: overtime on Leonard, Open Finance
Optimal Labor promo over the schedule
Grid: red overtime cells, TIME OFF, Budget
steal: Header counters for Conflicts and Overtime include a Fix warnings jump (screens 3, 5).
The hierarchy is Department, then Role, then Open Shifts row, then people (screens 1 to 2, 5).
Each row shows hours and cost plus red 'Total OT'; cells use a lightning mark and an Overtime label (screens 2, 5).
Import first schedule and Publish schedule sit in the same toolbar (screens 1, 3).
avoid: A point-of-sale (POS) Optimal Labor promo covering the grid mid-flow (screen 4) blocks scheduling work.
mobbin:9b6a37a7-8bbf-4883-a999-463f46cfb.fit: Scheduling: best conflict and overtime-on-resource-grid reference for room or faculty double-book and contact-hour warnings. The Import button aligns with the Excel master-file direction.

mobbin:5b627af5-e4b7-47ec-8d86-154da7cdb.summary: From the week grid, the manager opens Open Shifts, sets role, time and notes, offers to everyone, applies to days, and sees unassigned slots on Open Shifts rows.
steps: Week grid: Conflicts, overtime, Open Shifts
Week grid: plus on Open Shifts cells
Open Shifts panel: role, times, Offer, Apply Sat
Open Shifts panel: 11am to 7pm, notes, breaks
Open Shifts panel: Offer and notes filled
Grid after create: Open Shifts row, warnings
steal: A dedicated Open Shifts row per department holds unassigned capacity (screens 1 to 2, 6).
The Open Shifts form covers role, auto-calculated duration, and Offer to everyone at all locations (screens 3 to 5).
Apply to Mon to Sun day labels creates multi-day slots (screens 3 to 5).
Conflicts and overtime stay visible while creating open slots (screens 1 to 6).
mobbin:5b627af5-e4b7-47ec-8d86-154da7cdb.fit: Scheduling: self sign-up and unassigned session slots for rotations. Create open cells then claim; cheaper than full roster auto-gen when only gaps need filling.
